title: Staged operator onboarding & release comms for Private Fleet: RBAC templates, audit-retention migration, and KMS rotation play
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Coordinate a staged operator onboarding and external release communications program for Private Fleet features: role-based access control (RBAC), extended audit log retention and migration tooling, and customer KMS key rotation guidance. Goals: 1) Deliver a set of canonical RBAC templates (operator/auditor/developer/readonly) that map to Console roles and IaC snippets. 2) Publish an audit-retention migration plan and runbook with automated scripts for customers moving from 30d --> 365d retention. 3) Provide a customer-safe KMS rotation checklist including aliasing, key-rotation windows, and rollback procedures. 4) Run a 4-week pilot with 5 enterprise customers and capture operational telemetry, time-to-onboard, and post-migration errors. Success metrics: pilot onboarded by 2026-03-30; <2% production incidents attributable to migration; onboarding SLO: operator setup <= 2 hours for 80% of pilot customers.
comments: 2026-02-25: Kickoff with Eng (Lena Wong), Security (Jonas Meyer), and Solutions (Priya Rao). Agreed on pilot cohort criteria and initial timeline.
2026-03-02: RBAC canonical templates v0.1 delivered by Eng. Notes: needs mapping to Console role IDs and Terraform snippets. Action: Design to review labels/UX text.
2026-03-05: Solutions engineering asked for sample customer CSV import for role assignments; adding to runbook.
2026-03-08: Security requested mandatory HSM-backed key guidance for high-compliance customers; adding KMS appendix.
2026-03-10: Draft release notes outline complete; product comms to prepare localized summaries for EU customers re: data residency and audit retention changes.
2026-03-12: Added KMS aliasing guidance and emergency rollback procedure. Scheduling an on-call dry-run with SRE week of 2026-03-22.
launch_checklist: Finalize RBAC templates with Console role IDs and Terraform examples
Publish audit-retention migration script and test on staging with synthetic tenants
KMS rotation appendix + HSM advice + sample Key Policy JSON
Run pilot onboarding with 5 customers and collect telemetry
Prepare release notes and customer-facing KB articles (EN/EU)
Schedule training webinar for operators and solutions engineers
Coordinate with Sales for pilot invitations and incentives
Create rollback playbooks and SRE dry-run schedule
risks: Audit migration scripts might cause transient indexing errors for long-retention tenants
Customers using self-managed KMS may have incompatible aliasing or policy constraints
RBAC role mapping ambiguity between customer's existing groups and Console roles could slow onboarding
Regulatory/legal questions from EU customers about extended retention could require legal review and change comms
mitigations: Add a staged migration mode (dry-run, preview, commit) and retention backout command
Provide a troubleshooting appendix for common KMS provider errors and an SRE-assisted rotation option
Include a short questionnaire in onboarding to capture existing group mappings and create a mapper script
Coordinate early with Legal & Compliance; prepare templated data-retention FAQs and opt-out messaging for sensitive customers
notes: This ticket is intentionally structured as an operational playbook rather than a single feature toggle. Aim is to make rollout repeatable for future Private Fleet features. Follow-ups: create PM-77824 for post-pilot metrics analysis and PM-77825 for localization of KB articles.
